title: QUIZ - 28
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Use dimensional analysis to cancel units when multiplying rate by time
questions.question: A car travels at 5 km/h for 5 hours. Using dimensional analysis, what distance (in km) does it cover?
questions.explanation: Multiplying speed by time cancels the hour unit: \(5\text{ km/h}\times5\text{ h}=25\text{ km}\).
questions.hint: Multiply quantities so that matching units in the numerator and denominator cancel out.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the setup that keeps units consistent before combining quantities
questions.question: A student wants to find the distance traveled given a speed in km/h and a time in minutes. Which setup has consistent units throughout?

options.label: A
options.text: Multiply speed (km/h) directly by time (minutes) to get km.

options.label: B
options.text: Divide speed (km/h) by time (minutes) to get km.

options.label: C
options.text: Add speed (km/h) and time (minutes) directly to get km.

options.label: D
options.text: Convert the time to hours first, then multiply speed (km/h) by time (h) to get km.

questions.explanation: For the units to cancel correctly and yield km, the time must be expressed in hours (matching the 'per hour' in km/h) before multiplying.
questions.hint: Units must match before they can be multiplied or divided to cancel correctly.

questions.learningObjective: Chain a unit conversion with a rate calculation, tracking units throughout
questions.question: An ingredient costs $6 per kilogram. Using dimensional analysis, find the cost of 599 grams (rounded to two decimal places).
questions.explanation: Convert grams to kilograms: \(599\text{ g}\times\frac{1\text{ kg}}{1000\text{ g}}=0.599\text{ kg}\). Then \(0.599\text{ kg}\times\frac{6\text{ USD}}{1\text{ kg}}=3.594\text{ USD}\approx3.59\text{ USD}\).
questions.hint: Convert grams to kilograms first so the 'kg' units cancel when multiplied by the price per kilogram.
